statement: For iid standard Gaussian vertex weights on the planar lattice, let M_n be the maximum weight over all n-vertex up/right paths from the origin, with free endpoint and the origin counted. Improve the C n/log n variance upper bound beyond a logarithmic correction. The operational power goal is Var(M_n)<=C_epsilon n^(1-epsilon) for some fixed 0<epsilon<1 and all n>=2; this is a working formulation, not a literal quantifier in Section 12(3).
status_search: Primary-source scope corrected on 2026-10-10: arXiv:0810.4221v2 Sections 1, 8, 12(3) concern a planar iid Gaussian ground-state maximum. Finite-temperature log Z, arbitrary disorder and general dimension require separate sources. Current openness UNKNOWN; no complete proof or novelty claim is made.
title: Fluctuation exponent of directed polymers beyond the logarithmic improvement
